full_prompt_en: A square editorial fashion photograph frames a young woman tightly from the shoulders upward against a smooth muted sage-gray background. She faces the camera directly, her pale blue-green eyes level and expression composed. Dark brown hair is parted at the center and mostly covered by a rich crimson headscarf. A narrow patterned band crosses above the forehead, while the heavier cloth wraps around both sides of the face and gathers in thick folds beneath the chin. A matching red garment appears only at the lower corners, allowing the scarf and face to dominate. The complexion is softly luminous, with subtle warm blush around the cheeks, restrained shadow under the eyes and a small highlight along the nose. Full muted rose-red lips provide a quieter echo of the surrounding fabric. The background remains empty, its cool green-gray hue increasing the separation from the saturated red. The framing is almost symmetrical, though the folded scarf gathers more heavily on the lower right and one side of the hairline shows slightly more. Large soft studio light comes from the upper front left, giving even detail to the eyes and smooth skin while leaving gentle shadow along the scarf folds and neck. Fabric weave and the embroidered-looking band are visible without distracting from the clean facial focus. No jewelry, props or readable text appear. The overall composition is spare and arresting, using a calm direct gaze, controlled red framing and subdued cool ground to create intimate editorial tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形编辑式时尚照片把一名年轻女子从肩部以上贴近框住，背景是平滑、低调的鼠尾草灰绿色。她正对镜头，浅蓝绿色眼睛平视，神情沉静。深棕发在中央分开，大部分被浓绯红头巾盖住。窄花纹织带横过额头上方，较厚布料围住面庞两侧，在下巴下聚成厚褶。同色红衣只在下方两角露出，让头巾和面部占据主导。肤色柔和发亮，脸颊有轻微暖红，眼下阴影克制，鼻梁有一小道高光。饱满的低调玫红嘴唇较轻地呼应周围布料。背景保持空白，冷绿灰色使饱和红色更加分离。框景近乎对称，但头巾褶线在右下聚得更厚，一侧发际也稍多露出。大型柔和影棚光从左上前方而来，让眼睛与平滑皮肤细节均匀可见，巾褶与颈部只留温和阴影。布料经纬和近似刺绣的窄带可见，却不抢夺干净的面部焦点。没有首饰、道具或可读文字。整体构图简净而醒目，以沉静直视、受控红色框景和低调冷色底形成亲密的编辑式张力。
style_prompt_en: A restrained editorial-photography treatment isolates a saturated crimson color mass against a cool desaturated gray-green field. Broad smooth tonal transitions preserve a polished focal area, while fabriclike folds and a narrow patterned band provide the main tactile detail. Large soft frontal-side light keeps the central values luminous and shadows gentle, allowing the saturated hue to supply drama without harsh contrast. The composition is close, nearly symmetrical and spare; the strongest color wraps around a quieter pale center, with slight asymmetry in the lower folds. Edges stay clean where color meets background and softer within the shadowed material. The overall effect is intimate, graphic and quietly intense.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的编辑式摄影处理把饱和绯红色体量孤立在冷而降饱和的灰绿底前。宽阔平滑的明暗过渡保留光洁焦点区域，织物般褶线与一道狭窄花纹带提供主要触感细节。大型柔和前侧光使中央明度发亮、阴影温和，让饱和色调无需强硬反差也能形成戏剧性。构图贴近、近乎对称而简净；最强色彩包围较安静的浅色中心，下部褶线略微不对称。色彩与背景相接处边缘干净，暗色材料内部则更柔软。整体亲密、图形感强且安静地紧张。
theme_en: A direct fashion close-up of a woman framed by a deep red headscarf
theme_zh: 深红头巾围住女子的正面时尚特写
name: Vinoodh Matadin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
